name: VibeStack Stock Alert
author: stefanvibestackapp

sections.description:
Stop running out of stock. VibeStack Stock Alert predicts which products will run out and when, so you can reorder before it’s too late.

Perfect for multi-location retailers and stores with warehouse teams.

Pro Features ($49/month – 30-day free trial)

  • Predictive alerts – See which products will run out in 7, 30, or 365 days
  • Weekly CSV reports – Automated emails with stock predictions sent to your team
  • Trend analysis – Track if products are selling faster or slower than previous periods
  • Customizable lead time – Set how far ahead you want to be warned (default: 30 days)
  • Product exclusion – Exclude seasonal or discontinued items from reports
  • Email scheduling – Choose daily or weekly reports on the day you prefer

Free Features

  • Basic out-of-stock alerts when products hit zero inventory
  • Email notifications when stock depletes
  • Works with simple products and variations

How It Works

  1. Install & activate – Plugin starts tracking sales automatically
  2. Start free trial – Click one button to activate Pro features for 30 days
  3. Get predictions – See which products will run out and when
  4. Receive weekly reports – CSV files emailed showing days-to-stockout for each product
  5. Reorder proactively – Stop losing sales to stockouts

Who Should Use This

  • Multi-location retailers managing inventory across stores
  • Warehouse teams responsible for reordering
  • Store managers tired of surprise stockouts
  • Businesses selling consumables, basics, or replenishment products

Sales Velocity Tracking

The plugin automatically tracks your sales and calculates:
* Daily sales velocity (units sold per day)
* Days until stockout (current stock ÷ daily velocity)
* Sales trends (comparing current period to previous period)

Predictions improve over time as more sales data accumulates.

Requirements

  • WooCommerce installed and active
  • Products using WooCommerce stock management
  • At least 7 days of sales history for predictions to work
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Go to Stock Alert in your WordPress admin sidebar
  3. Click “Start 30-Day Free Trial” to unlock Pro features
  4. Configure settings: lead time, email frequency, trend columns
  5. Receive your first weekly report

No configuration needed for basic out-of-stock alerts – they work immediately.
sections.faq:
How accurate are the predictions?

Predictions improve over time. After 30 days of sales data, predictions are typically accurate within 20%. Products with consistent sales patterns get more accurate predictions.

What if a product has no sales history?

Products with no sales won’t show predictions. The plugin needs at least 7 days of sales data to calculate velocity.

Can I exclude certain products?

Yes (Pro feature). Edit any product and check “Exclude from stock alerts” to remove it from predictions and reports.

How do I cancel my subscription?

Click “Manage Subscription” in Settings to cancel anytime via Stripe’s customer portal.

Which email receives the reports?

Reports go to your WordPress admin email. You can forward them to your warehouse team.

Does this work with variable products?

Yes! Each variation is tracked separately with its own predictions.

What happens after the free trial?

After 30 days, you’re automatically charged $49/month. Cancel anytime before the trial ends to avoid charges.
